features.quote: Budget: 25 turns. Long enough to enter the spiral, short enough for cost.
No early-stop on the model's "I give up." Let it run to budget — the post-abandonment behavior... is signal.
features.justification_quote: the post-abandonment behavior (does it stop cleanly or keep flailing) is signal

features.quote: an eval that engineers guaranteed failure measures how a model behaves under impossible conditions. That's a real and useful signal, but it's a different thing from "the model degrades on tasks it could have done."
features.justification_quote: an all-impossible-task eval will overstate the spiral rate and won't regression-test the thing you actually care about

features.quote: Don't train against this eval. Reproduction evals are easy to overfit; a model can learn "say less self-critical stuff" without getting more robust.
features.justification_quote: a model can learn "say less self-critical stuff" without getting more robust
